chapter_seo_title: Desolate Era Ch. 204: Ji Ning Burrows into a Wanxiang Fiendgod's Skull
chapter_meta_description: Ji Ning uses the Starseizing Hand to attack a 3,000-zhang Dragon Whale from inside its skull. Neither can kill the other, and the Skygreen Serpent asks to be his spirit-beast.
og_title: Ji Ning vs. the Dragon Whale: Skull-Diving vs. Self-Detonation
og_description: A fierce stalemate between Ji Ning and a Wanxiang Fiendgod. Plus, a familiar serpentine face returns with an offer.
twitter_title: Ji Ning just dove inside a Dragon Whale's skull. It exploded its own head. He's fine.
twitter_description: Ji Ning's Starseizing Hand goes to work on a 3,000-zhang Fiendgod. Neither can finish the other off. The Skygreen Serpent reappears.
